scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix client && npm run format --prefix server
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.prod: npm run generate --prefix server && npm run db:push --prefix server && npm run db:seed --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client && concurrently "node server/index.js" "npm run preview --prefix client"
